name: std::iswupper
intro:
Checks if the given wide character is an uppercase letter, i.e. one of ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ or any uppercase letter specific to the current locale.

If the value of ch is neither representable as a wchar_t nor equal to the value of the macro WEOF, the behavior is undefined.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: Non-zero value if the wide character is an uppercase letter, zero otherwise.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: ISO 30112 specifies which Unicode characters are include in POSIX upper category.

examples.output:
in the default locale, iswupper(0x53d) = false
in Unicode locale, iswupper(0x53d) = true
